# Code of Conduct

We want Weft to be a good place to work, for everyone, whatever their experience or background.

## What we expect

- Be kind and assume good faith.
- Criticise code and ideas, not people.
- Accept feedback, and give it in a way that helps.
- Make room for people who are new.

## What we won't accept

- Harassment, insults or personal attacks, in public or in private.
- Sexual language or imagery, or unwanted attention.
- Discriminating against anyone for who they are.
- Publishing someone's private information without their permission.
- Anything else that would be plainly out of place among people working together.

## Reporting

Use the same private route as a security report: open a private report from the repository's **Security** tab, as
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) describes, and say it's about conduct. Reports are kept private.

## What happens

Maintainers will look at every report, and may remove content, or warn or ban someone from the project. This applies in all of
the project's spaces, and whenever someone is representing it.

This code is based on the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org), version 2.1.
